parse.title: Julias
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 19 - Winter + Re-release Update

Overview

Julias is a Exclusive Limited unit. He is a Tournament-exclusive (preceding Messi and succeeding Deer-tan), only obtainable by clearing the tournament on the 99.00% ~ 99.89% ranking reward, with his shiny being the 99.90% ~ 100% ranking reward.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
